# tailor_organization_ip_restriction (Resource)

The organization IP restriction resource configures an IP allowlist applied to the organization's workspaces. Requests whose client IP does not match any of the listed CIDR blocks are rejected at the routing layer.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `allowed_ip_addresses` (List of String) List of allowed IPv4/IPv6 addresses or CIDR blocks. Each entry must be a public address; private, loopback, and multicast ranges are rejected.
- `organization_id` (String) The ID of the organization. Changing this forces replacement.
